main_body: Open bookshelf with a brown frame and three shelves holding scrolls, books and a chest, drawn mostly face-on
top_band: salmon/light brown cap, rows ~1-3, then a darker brown frame row below; the shelf interior is drawn flat from the front
evidence: Down the middle column there is a thin 3-row salmon cap on a 32-row object, then the face-on front. The cap has no distinct front-edge highlight and is much shallower than the guide's 5-row cabinet top. Shelves, books and scrolls are all vertical faces seen head-on, and the shelf boards are only 1-2 row bands. The inset interior is dark, but the whole piece reads as a front elevation with a thin cap, so it fails.

style.evidence: The outline is a tinted dark brown, which is good. The frame has about 4 tones and the books carry some colour variety. The large dark shelf-back areas are flat fills, and the frame and cap have little grain or per-plank texture. Next to the stall and well references, which are richer in texture and more varied in material, it looks thinner and flatter.
